{{Quote|Shell-bat&hellip;Flying reptile from my world.''"<br />"''Which planet is that?''"<br />"''Geran, Mneon System.|[[Doallyn/Legends|Doallyn]] and [[Yarna d'al' Gargan/Legends|Yarna d'al' Gargan]]|<ref name="Skin Deep" />}}
The '''Mneon system''',<ref name="Skin Deep" /> also known as the '''Geran system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geran/Legends|Geran]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Geranite/Legends|Geranite]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and flying [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] known as [[shell-bat]]s.<ref name="Skin Deep" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mneon system was first mentioned in "[[Skin Deep: The Fat Dancer's Tale]]," a short story written by [[A. C. Crispin]]<ref name="Skin Deep" /> and published in ''[[Tales from Jabba's Palace]]'''', a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] anthology edited by [[Kevin J. Anderson]]<ref name="Tales from Jabba's Palace">''[[Tales from Jabba's Palace]]''</ref> and released in [[December]] [[1995]].<ref name="Jabba">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/3549/tales-from-jabbas-palace-star-wars-legends-by-kevin-anderson-editor/9780553568158|text=Tales from Jabba's Palace: Star Wars Legends}}</ref> ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and released on [[August 18]], [[2009]],<ref name="TEA release date">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> placed the system in grid square T-9.<ref name="TEA" />
